Data coverage & calculation

Token lookup uses GeckoTerminal and DEX Screener. Individual swaps come from GeckoTerminal, across up to 3 of the most liquid pools found per selected listing. Pools found through DEX Screener may not have swap data available in GeckoTerminal. Each request returns at most 300 recent swaps per pool from the past 24 hours. Smaller pools, unindexed tokens, other exchanges, and older swaps may be missing. Select all combines the shown search matches only; it does not establish that they are official versions of the same token.

The selected time window filters the returned sample; it does not fetch a complete history. Combined flow adds USD values across your selected chains and contracts. Swaps between two selected contracts on the same chain are excluded from combined flow. Individual views still show those swaps. Net buy volume is observed buy USD volume minus observed sell USD volume, not total capital inflow or a price forecast. Multi-pool routes can contain multiple swap steps. Transaction groups keep these steps together without changing chart totals. Table filters apply to individual steps and do not change the charts. Token quantity and execution price describe each swap step. Transaction sender addresses may represent routers or smart accounts rather than individual traders.

Size bands: S < $100; M $100–<$1,000; L $1,000–<$10,000; XL ≥ $10,000. Duplicate events are counted once per chain. Pool requests are shared when selected contracts use the same pool. Automatic refresh runs every 60 seconds while this page is visible. Up to three requests can overlap; request starts are paced to reduce rate limits. Pool discovery is cached for five minutes and swap responses for 30 seconds. Switching listings cancels obsolete requests.
